_comment: THE THIRD-PARTY NOTICE MANIFEST (NOTICES-1, 2026-09-18). ONE declaration per
vendored component; the LICENCE TEXT IS NEVER WRITTEN HERE — it is read out of
the vendored tree itself at build time (cmake/Notices.cmake turns each entry
into a resource, either the licence file straight or an extracted line range
from the file that carries the notice), so a licence text in the shipped binary
cannot drift from the one in the tree. `app.notices()` serves this list and the
About dialog's Third-party notices page shows it.
EVERY ENTRY: id (stable, script-facing), name, role (what it does for us, in one
line), homepage, licence (the SPDX-ish short name, for the list column only —
the TEXT is the authority), path (the vendored directory, repo-relative), file
(the notice file inside it) or lines ([first, last] of a file that carries the
notice in a comment). `optional: true` = a component that may be absent from a
checkout (an uninitialised submodule) — the build then embeds a note saying so
COVERAGE IS A TEST, not a habit: source.notices_coverage walks thirdparty/ and
irisgl/thirdparty/ and fails on a vendored directory no entry claims.

components.name: OGRE-Next
components.role: The 3D engine Jahshaka renders with (Vulkan), carried as a pinned submodule plus this repository's own patch stack.

components.name: Open Asset Import Library (assimp)
components.role: Reads model files at import time (glTF, FBX, OBJ and the rest). Import-time only — nothing it produces is on the render path.

components.name: Bullet Physics SDK
components.role: The physics simulation behind rigid bodies, constraints and the character controller.

components.name: meshoptimizer
components.role: Builds each imported mesh's level-of-detail chain at import (simplification and vertex-cache optimisation).

components.name: meshoptimizer (cluster LOD branch)
components.role: The cluster-level-of-detail work from the same project, vendored beside it for the Atom program.

components.name: zip
components.role: Reads and writes the .zip containers projects are exported and imported as.

components.name: Qlementine
components.role: The Qt style Jahshaka's dark theme is built on — vendored as first-class source (ours to edit) rather than a submodule.

components.name: QtAwesome
components.role: Draws the icon font the toolbars and panels use.

components.name: Google Breakpad
components.role: The crash reporter. Built only when DISABLE_BREAKPAD is off, and off in every development build.

components.name: WebXR Input Profiles assets
components.role: The Meta Quest Touch Pro controller meshes drawn as the wearer's hands in VR, baked to .obj from the upstream glTF assets.
